q.description: A natural-language US Census question. Specify the indicators, geographies (states, counties, cities/places, or ZIP codes), and years of interest in plain English. Examples: 'What is the poverty rate in Chicago, IL?'; 'Compare the median household income and work from home percentage in Seattle, WA and Portland, OR in 2022.'; 'Which counties in Washington state have the highest bachelor's degree percentages?'
